title: Websites you can actually use.
intro: Ten complete, clickable demos, each in its own design style: websites for seven kinds of business, plus a custom web app, a business automation hub and an AI assistant with custom skills. Every business, person, price and address is fictional; photos were generated with AI, and the AI answers are scripted examples.

concepts.name: FORM
concepts.description: Renovation and interiors studio in a bold industrial style: condensed capitals, hard edges and a safety-yellow accent, with a three-step estimate as the one clear next step.

concepts.name: COMMON
concepts.description: Ceramics, linen and glass store in a modern editorial style: a magazine-style cover, a big italic serif and hairline product grids, with a slide-out bag, free-shipping bar and three-step demo checkout.

concepts.name: STUDIO
concepts.description: Yoga and breathwork studio in a soft organic style: cream, sage and blush with rounded arches. Built around a live two-week schedule with booking, class packs, rescheduling and cancellation.

concepts.name: SPACES
concepts.description: Real estate brokerage in a dark luxury style: black, ivory and gold. Home search with filters and saved homes, listing pages with a photo lightbox, payment calculator and viewing requests, plus an instant valuation.

concepts.name: Luna
concepts.description: Taquería with online ordering in a bold, playful style: chunky Bricolage Grotesque, chili red, cream and marigold. Menu with dish customization, a cart with ZIP-checked delivery, fees, tax and tip, a demo checkout and live order tracking, plus catering quotes.

concepts.name: Hale & Whitaker
concepts.description: Law firm in a classic, authoritative style: Libre Caslon, forest green, parchment and brass. Practice area pages, attorney bios, sample results with disclaimers, a contingency fee estimator and a multi-step free case evaluation that books a consultation.

concepts.name: Ironwood
concepts.description: Plumbing and HVAC company in a rugged, friendly style: Rubik, navy, service blue and safety orange. Service-area check, five-step booking with arrival windows, upfront price estimator, membership, emergency guide and a live technician tracker.

concepts.name: Workbench
concepts.description: Project management web app in a crisp product style: zinc, black and violet, light and dark mode. Dashboard, drag-and-drop board, task details with checklists and comments, file uploads and settings.

concepts.name: RELAY
concepts.description: Business automation hub for a service company in a technical console style: black and electric lime. Automation flows as node graphs with test runs, streaming logs and output previews, editable templates, run history and an ROI calculator. Runs are simulated; nothing is sent.

concepts.name: Skillset
concepts.description: Side-by-side comparison of a generic AI and an AI with a business’s own skills, in an airy aurora glass style. Presets for three businesses, skill toggles that change the answer, citations and action cards. All responses are scripted; no AI model runs on the page.
